Hi Mina,

We just signed up a few developers under our sandbox org and I applied the promo code you provided (ACME-REDWOOD-2028). The UI shows the promo as "Applied" on the billing page, and I received a JSON receipt from checkout (attached), but under the usage/wallet dashboard the credit balance is $0 and our pods are getting throttled. Can you confirm whether the credits were actually issued?

Screenshot attached (screenshot-wallet-zero.png) — you can see the "Applied" badge but the balance column reads $0.

We’re in the middle of onboarding a pilot and this is blocking a demo later this week. If you can either re-issue the trial credit or provide a manual override for the sandbox org that would be great.

Thanks,
Alex Li
Developer Ops, Acme Sandbox

Thanks Mina / Alex, I pulled the issuance logs for promo code ACME-REDWOOD-2028. Summary: the entitlement job ran and posted an issuance event to the ledger service (ledger_txn_id=ledg_20280514_9ab3). However, the wallet microservice returned a 202 Accepted and we didn't receive the final wallet-update webhook from the ledger ingestion consumer — looks like the consumer crashed on one partition and reprocessing is delayed.

Immediate remediation options:
- Option A: Force a manual reconciliation for org id acme-sandbox-31 (I can trigger now). This will replay ledger events and update the wallet balance. Estimated time: ~10 minutes, no downtime.
- Option B: If you need a quick unblock for the demo, we can apply a temporary promo manual credit of $300 to the org (audit log entry created). That’s reversible once the ledger replay delivers the original issuance.

Action requested from Mina/Marissa: please confirm which option you want me to take.

Debug notes (for postmortem):
- Issuance event: ledg_20280514_9ab3 -> payload verified against promo id.
- Consumer error: out-of-memory on partition 3 at 2028-05-14T12:38:22Z; restarted but backlog pending.

— Dev

Hi all — thanks for the investigation, Dev. Alex — to minimize customer impact for your pilot, we’ll do Option B (temporary manual credit) now and follow up with the ledger replay to ensure the official issuance lands. I’ve approved a $300 temporary credit and created an audit ticket: AUDIT-2028-5561.

Alex — you should see the sandbox wallet reflect the $300 within ~2 minutes. Please try spinning up the demo pods and let me know if throttling stops. Once ledger replay completes, we’ll reconcile and either leave the issuance (if it matches) or roll back and notify you.

Going to document this in the deal notes and open a postmortem runbook item for the consumer crash. Apologies for the friction.

— Marissa
